extension_evidence.logic: Let S be the number of supplied seeds and R = ceil(30 / S). Each seed first runs R schedules. If any shared witness is deficient, each seed draws one more schedule at offset R + extraRun. There are at most R such rounds. A batch finishes for every seed before coverage is checked again. The maximum is 2 × S × R scheduled cases before shrink/replay, and the normal 11 unique default seeds give 33 initial and at most 66 cases. This historical single-seed configuration starts at 30 and caps at 60. Each schedule allows up to 18 generated commands with preconditions.
extension_evidence.witnesses: At least 100 accepted commands, at least one acknowledged WebSocket tempo write, one WebSocket swing write, and one disconnect while the model’s live and KV state differ. An accepted action calls the real owner and compares expected state through REST, KV and socket observations. A property failure is handled immediately before any coverage top-up. The other seven command kinds are generated but each is not independently required by the final predicate.
extension_evidence.same_stream: The fixed package implements a single numeric fast-check path by dropping that many initial producers from the same seed’s generator stream. It honors numRuns when that path has no shrink segment. The repair uses the original signed seed and increasing case offsets. In a disposable diagnostic we recorded all accepted action objects and cumulative coverage after each successful real model schedule. All 32 records were byte-identical to one uninterrupted 32-case run of the original generator with the same seed.
extension_evidence.cost: For this seed the repair executed two extra schedules. Case 31 had no accepted action. Case 32 sent swing 50 and disconnected, raising 99 to 101 and three dirty closes to four. The uninstrumented paired local Vitest process times and isolated repeats are in the matrix. Each extra fc.check reinitializes a runner and advances to an offset. The outer test timeout is unchanged at max(120000, 15000 × S) ms. interruptAfterTimeLimit is per fc.check, including each extra call. No suite-wide runtime multiplier or all-seed success rate was measured.

diagnostic_attempts.reason: The first successful runs emitted no console.log records. Their empty traces give no stream comparison. The retained follow-ups accumulated records, ran the original coverage assertion and then deliberately raised a diagnostic error to deliver the trace. The added diagnostic exit supplies observations only. The frozen uninstrumented runs establish pass/fail.

other_reported_findings.change: Only the production Waveform.tsx assignments to mins[i] and maxs[i] are replaced by zeros. This establishes insensitivity of these four tests. Browser canvas output and the rest of the suite were not evaluated on this fault.
